column1: # Every field is a MEASURED value, not a restatement of the build
# command.  The build receipt identity is the pair (nonce, probe
# output), which is what the provenance witness binds.
# NOTE: the witness and these receipts are regenerated together by
# the parser-slice05-provenance target.  During the C3 qualification
# the hcc-bootstrap02 and hcc-bootstrap03 binaries were rebuilt, which
# made the earlier witness STALE; the verifier DETECTED that staleness
# (G2_COMPILER_IDENTITY_MISMATCH) and the witness was regenerated.  That
# is the check doing its job.
#   The G0 producing compiler is the ACTUAL HOST C COMPILER
#   (/usr/bin/cc), because the G0 object is a C build.  No
#   reporting-rule substitution of ./hcc for G0's C compiler.
# EACH GENERATION WAS BUILT BY ITS OWN COMPILER AND EXECUTED.
# NO GENERATION'S OUTPUT WAS COPIED AS A SUBSTITUTE FOR ANOTHER
